recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Pasta
recipes.description: A quick weeknight pasta tossed in a silky garlic and parmesan sauce.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente, then reserve a mug of pasta water.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large pan and gently fry the sliced garlic until fragrant but not browned.
Pour in the cream, bring to a gentle simmer and stir in most of the parmesan.
Toss the drained pasta in the sauce, loosening with pasta water until glossy.
Serve topped with parsley, black pepper and the remaining parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
recipes.description: A fragrant, creamy coconut curry that is even better the next day.
instructions: Fry the chopped onion in a little oil until soft, then stir in the curry paste for a minute.
Add the diced chicken and cook until sealed on all sides.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Veggie Stir-fry
recipes.description: Crispy tofu and broccoli in a sticky soy glaze, ready in 20 minutes.
instructions: Cook the rice and keep it warm.
Press the tofu dry, cut into cubes and fry in a hot wok until golden on all sides.
Add the broccoli florets and grated ginger and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce and maple syrup and toss until everything is glazed.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Peanut Noodles
recipes.description: Slurpable noodles in a nutty, tangy sauce. Great hot or cold.
instructions: Boil the noodles until just tender, then rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce and lime juice with a splash of hot water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce.
Top with sliced spring onions and cucumber matchsticks.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken with Potatoes
recipes.description: The Sunday classic: crisp skin, juicy meat and potatoes roasted in the drippings.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Stuff the chicken with the halved lemon and rosemary, then rub with oil and salt.
Toss the chopped potatoes and garlic cloves in oil and arrange them around the chicken.
Roast in the oven for about 1 hour 20 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Homemade pizza with a blistered crust, tomato, mozzarella and basil.
instructions: Mix the flour, yeast, a pinch of salt and 200 ml warm water into a dough and knead for 10 minutes.
Leave to rise for 1 hour, then heat the oven to its highest setting.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases and spread with passata.
Top with torn mozzarella and bake in the oven for 8–10 minutes until blistered.
Finish with basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Spiced beef in warm tortillas with all the fresh toppings.
instructions: Brown the beef in a hot pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the paprika, a pinch of cumin and a splash of water; cook for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with the beef, chopped tomatoes and grated cheddar, and squeeze over the lime.

recipes.title: Grilled Lemon Salmon
recipes.description: Charred salmon fillets with lemon and garlic. Light, quick and healthy.
instructions: Mix the lemon zest and juice, crushed garlic, oil and chopped dill.
Marinate the salmon for 10 minutes.
Heat the grill to high and grill the salmon skin-side up for 6–8 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy, salty and fresh. No cooking required.
instructions: No cooking needed: chop the cucumber and tomatoes into chunks.
Thinly slice the red onion and add it with the olives.
Top with a slab of feta, sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A thick, warming soup made from store-cupboard staples.
instructions: Soften the chopped onion and carrot in a large pot with a little oil.
Stir in the cumin, then add the rinsed lentils and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blend until smooth and season with lemon juice and salt.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy, comforting risotto with earthy mushrooms and parmesan.
instructions: Fry the sliced mushrooms in half the butter until golden, then set aside.
Soften the shallots, add the rice and stir for a minute.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring until each is absorbed, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms, parmesan and remaining butter and rest for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.description: Thick American-style pancakes for a lazy weekend breakfast.
instructions: Whisk the flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Beat in the eggs and milk to make a thick batter.
Cook ladlefuls in a lightly oiled pan over a medium heat until bubbles appear, then flip.
Serve stacked with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
instructions: Soften the sliced onion and peppers in a deep frying pan.
Add the spices, then the tomatoes, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make six wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and simmer for 6–8 minutes until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay Skewers
recipes.description: Smoky grilled chicken skewers with a rich peanut dipping sauce.
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips and marinate in tamari, garlic and lime for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway.
Warm the peanut butter with the coconut milk to make the sauce.
Serve the skewers with the sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Dense, gooey brownies with a crackly top. Perfect for sharing.
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a square tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together, then let cool slightly.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and thick, then fold in the chocolate.
Sift in the flour and cocoa, fold gently and pour into the tin.
Bake in the oven for 25 minutes; cool completely before cutting.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Smashed avocado on crunchy sourdough with a kick of chilli. Breakfast for one.
instructions: Toast the sourdough until golden.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread over the toast and finish with chilli flakes.
